sql_2fb5183dc315cfbf721aecae.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.SystemAlertId,s.AlertName,s.TimeGenerated,s.StartTime,JSON_EXTRACT(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(s.Entities) THEN s.Entities ELSE '[]' END, '$[*].Address') AS IPAddresses FROM SecurityAlert s JOIN JSON_TABLE(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(s.Entities) THEN s.Entities ELSE '[]' END, '$[*]' COLUMNS(EntityType VARCHAR(64) PATH '$.Type', AccountObjectId VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.AadUserId')) a ON a.EntityType='account' WHERE a.AccountObjectId=:p1 AND s.AlertName LIKE :p2 LIMIT 100

sql_550f93ed8baae22b273cad25.sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.AlertId,a.Title,a.TimeGenerated,a.AccountObjectId,a.AccountSid,a.AccountUpn,a.AccountName,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(a.AdditionalFields) THEN a.AdditionalFields ELSE '{}' END, '$.DisplayName')) AS AccountDisplayName FROM AlertEvidence k JOIN AlertEvidence a ON k.AlertId=a.AlertId WHERE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(k.AdditionalFields) THEN k.AdditionalFields ELSE '{}' END, '$.DisplayName'))=:p1 AND k.Title LIKE :p2 AND a.AccountObjectId<>'' LIMIT 100

sql_9447c700679b5f5518ce8f58.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.SystemAlertId,s.AlertName,s.TimeGenerated,a.AccountObjectId FROM SecurityAlert s JOIN JSON_TABLE(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(s.Entities) THEN s.Entities ELSE '[]' END, '$[*]' COLUMNS(EntityType VARCHAR(64) PATH '$.Type', AccountObjectId VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.AadUserId')) a ON a.EntityType='account' WHERE JSON_SEARCH(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(s.Entities) THEN s.Entities ELSE '[]' END,'one',:p1,NULL,'$**.Address') IS NOT NULL AND s.AlertName LIKE :p2 AND a.AccountObjectId IS NOT NULL LIMIT 100
